# Practice

::: {.lede}
I worked on legislative strategy and regulatory design.
:::

::: {.marginnote}
**Presidency of Chile**

Chief of the Legal Office

Legal adviser
:::

As Chief of the Legal Office of the Office of the President of Chile, I
provided advice on legislative strategy and regulatory design to the highest
levels of the government and led a team of more than 20 distinguished
attorneys. Previously, I served as legal counsel to that institution. I
served President Gabriel Boric from 2022 to 2026.

::: {.marginnote}
**Constitutional Court of Chile**

Law clerk
:::

As a Law Clerk at the Constitutional Court of Chile, I worked in the area of
constitutional review, conducting research on constitutional theory and
reviewing case law from constitutional courts around the world. I served
under Justice Carlos Carmona from 2012 to 2014.
